riskAcceptance.reason: The pfSense administration/API listener on 10443 is a trusted-source-only endpoint. FastAPI Cloud is not an approved administration source: direct reachability from that runtime is a negative exposure check and a security-policy failure. Keep administration limited to approved stable sources, use dedicated least-privilege API identities, and move durable posture/Snort telemetry to an out-of-band observer.

home.albandrieu.com:10443 aliases the pfSense administration/API listener. This source-aware policy permits only approved stable administration sources; FastAPI Cloud direct reachability is intentionally treated as a policy failure until a controlled workload identity or out-of-band observer is used.
